theorems.name: Submission.slicing_mb_dm_density_le_lowerLeftDini
theorems.statement: ∀ (ν : Measure ℝ) (a b : ℝ), ν (Ioo a b) ≠ ∞ → ∀ t ∈ Ioo a b, liminf (fun h : ℝ => ν (Icc (t - h) t) / ENNReal.ofReal h) (𝓝[>] 0) ≤ liminf (fun k : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal (((ν (Ioo a b ∩ Iic t)).toReal - (ν (Ioo a b ∩ Iic (t - k))).toReal) / k)) (𝓝[>] 0)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
